description.value:
Frequency once per day

Requirement You spend the night within 30 feet of your Ward.

You keep the Long Watch: you go without sleep for a full night's rest while remaining within 30 feet of your Ward. You don't become fatigued for missing that rest, and at dawn you regain Conviction as if you had rested, but you regain no Hit Points for the night and gain nothing else a rest would give. A second Long Watch on consecutive nights makes you fatigued as normal.
